# Protocol

CAR T cell sample was obtained by Rediet Mulatu from patient at APH and D14 time points. 5 uL of TruStain FcX was added to each sample, and samples were allowed to incubate in the fridge for at least 5 minutes.

While samples were incubated with FcX, the antibody cocktail was prepared according to the following table:

![](/images/fullpanel.png)

Cells were aliquoted into unstained, backbone, and full stain samples for both the APH and D14 samples. Antibody cocktail was added to the appropriate samples.

After overnight incubation, 1 mL of PBS was added to samples, which were then centrifuged at 300xg for 5 minutes. Supernatent was discarded and samples were resuspended in 180 uL of PBS.

Backbone and full stain samples for both time points were then incubated for 15 minutes with 2 uL of CAR detection reagent, washed, and then stained with 1 uL of PE-biotin for CAR detection. 

Samples were then washed once again, by centrifugation at 300xg for 5 mins. Supernatent was discarded and samples were once again resuspended in 180 uL of PBS. 

5uL of 7-AAD viability dye was added to backbone and full stains, and allowed to incubate for 5 minutes in the fridge. 

Samples were then anaylzed on the Aurora-4, and unmixed using the overnight SC controls collected on this day (7/28).
